note: Only formats that earn shares: receipts on the stories Kenyans are already on (Sauti, Set It Straight, Follow the Money, Promise Tracker, Chapter Six Test), scam alerts, and two Your Say polls a week (Thursday and Sunday, posted as Reels: people vote A or B in the comments). Daily hot posts, Tazama Hii clips and Hatutasahau anniversaries come on top.

campus.voice: Fast, funny Kenyan English, campus references (CATs, comrades, hostels, group chats). Study hacks, first jobs, side income.

young_pro.who: Young professionals in their first jobs
young_pro.voice: Sharp Kenyan English with a wink. AI at work, productivity, promotions, money moves.

creator.voice: Trend-literate, meme-aware. Editing hacks, AI for content, growth, brand deals.

hustle.voice: Practical Kenyan English. Selling online, WhatsApp Business, M-Pesa tills, automation.

techie.voice: Nerdy but never gatekeeping. Builds, tools, how things work under the hood.

diaspora.who: Young Africans abroad and friends on other continents
diaspora.voice: Kenyan English that explains local terms. African innovation, comparisons, connection.

everyone.voice: Simple Kenyan English. One question anyone can answer.

whatsapp_channel.how: Forward the approved image + caption from Telegram. WhatsApp Channels have no public posting API.

tiktok_reels.how: Weekly: turn the Kesho Kutwa carousel into a 30s slideshow with voice-over (script generated).

radio.how: Weekly 2-minute community radio segment (script generated) for people without smartphones.

sms.how: Optional: weekly Usiibiwe tip by SMS to opted-in subscribers via Africa's Talking (script generated, max 160 chars).
